unlisted_practices: Simulated multi-turn patient interactions with clinically grounded profiles, tools and longitudinal memory for evaluating mental health chatbots
Psychologist-developed operational rubrics replacing Likert-scale LLM-as-a-judge scoring

screen.reason: The paper introduces a synthetic simulation and benchmarking harness (MindSim and MHQR) to evaluate conversational LLMs for mental health support, but it evaluates model capabilities rather than testing a specific deployment practice or operational guardrail.
